symbols.name: label-space dimension
symbols.meaning: The dimension of the bilinear space in which all labels live, equal to h^3.
symbols.quote: Subspace labels attach nondegenerate subspaces of a fixed $m$-dimensional bilinear space to the vertices of the [linear exchange network](linear-network.md) on $W$ wires so its total edge cost $s$ falls below $Wm$ as recursive saving requires.

symbols.name: ground-set size
symbols.meaning: The number of points (100) from which the three-element subsets are drawn.
symbols.quote: Triples are three-element subsets of $h=100$ points; a bank has $N=\binom h3^3$ wires $X_a$ or $Y_a$ indexed by triples of triples $a=(a_1,a_2,a_3);$ there are $I=3\binom h3^2$ invocations with $c$ central wires each $(c_{\rm b}=100$ bit, $c_{\rm c}=101$ complex); $m=h^3.$

symbols.name: lost dimension
symbols.meaning: The total label dimension lost on the decreasing edges of the network.
symbols.quote: The saving needs the dimension $L$ lost on decreasing edges small relative to $N.$

symbols.name: coordinate space
symbols.meaning: The h-dimensional space carrying a nondegenerate symmetric bilinear form: Q^h with the modified form in the bit network, F_2^h with the dot product in the complex one.
symbols.quote: The bit network uses $F=\mathbb Q^h$ with nondegenerate $\langle g,g'\rangle=g\cdot g'-\frac19(\sum_kg_k)(\sum_kg'_k)$ of eigenvalues $1$ and $-91/9.$

symbols.name: triple indicator
symbols.meaning: The indicator vector in F of the triple T.
symbols.quote: Triple indicators $t_S,t_T$ have coordinate sum $3,$ so $\langle t_S,t_T\rangle=|S\cap T|-\frac{3\cdot3}9=|S\cap T|-1$ and $\langle t_T,t_T\rangle=2;$ the complex network uses $F=\mathbb F_2^h$ with the dot product, $t_S\cdot t_T=|S\cap T|\bmod 2.$

symbols.name: label space
symbols.meaning: The space F tensor F tensor F of h x h x h arrays, with the factorwise bilinear form, in which every label is a subspace.
symbols.quote: Labels lie in $\mathcal F=F^{\otimes3}$ of $h\times h\times h$ arrays, $g\otimes g'\otimes g''$ having entries $g_{k_1}g'_{k_2}g''_{k_3}$ and forms multiplying factorwise.

symbols.name: index tensor
symbols.meaning: The tensor product of the indicators of the three triples of a.
symbols.quote: Put $u_a=t_{a_1}\otimes t_{a_2}\otimes t_{a_3}$ and $U_a=\langle u_a\rangle.$

symbols.name: index line
symbols.meaning: The line spanned by u_a, the source label of X_a.
symbols.quote: Put $u_a=t_{a_1}\otimes t_{a_2}\otimes t_{a_3}$ and $U_a=\langle u_a\rangle.$

symbols.name: stage number
symbols.meaning: The stage (1, 2 or 3), which operates on the j-th coordinate of the index a.
symbols.quote: At stage $j$ put $A=F^{\otimes(j-1)},\ P=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}\rangle,\ B=P^\perp\subset A$ and $K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_3}\rangle;$ with $T$ the wire's $j$th triple, labels move

symbols.name: exposed factors
symbols.meaning: The tensor power of F over the j-1 coordinates already exposed at stage j.
symbols.quote: At stage $j$ put $A=F^{\otimes(j-1)},\ P=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}\rangle,\ B=P^\perp\subset A$ and $K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_3}\rangle;$ with $T$ the wire's $j$th triple, labels move

symbols.name: exposed index line
symbols.meaning: The line in A spanned by the tensor of the indicators of the first j-1 triples of a.
symbols.quote: At stage $j$ put $A=F^{\otimes(j-1)},\ P=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}\rangle,\ B=P^\perp\subset A$ and $K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_3}\rangle;$ with $T$ the wire's $j$th triple, labels move

symbols.name: complement of P

symbols.quote: At stage $j$ put $A=F^{\otimes(j-1)},\ P=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}\rangle,\ B=P^\perp\subset A$ and $K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_3}\rangle;$ with $T$ the wire's $j$th triple, labels move

symbols.name: later index line

symbols.name: projection onto a label
symbols.meaning: The projection onto the label U along its orthogonal complement.
symbols.quote: Bit-network label $U$ gets the [address shear](address-shear.md) by the projection $\Pi_U$ onto $U$ along $U^\perp$ $(-\Pi_{U_a}$ at sources of $X_a);$ so every route gets the shear $\mathrm{id}:$ $\Pi_{U_a^\perp}-(-\Pi_{U_a})$ on $X_a\to Y_a$ and $\Pi_{\mathcal F}-0$ elsewhere.

symbols.name: phase frame
symbols.meaning: The frame given to a vertex with label U in the complex network.
symbols.quote: A complex-network label $U$ gets $\mathcal C_U=H^{\otimes m}\operatorname{diag}_x(i^{q_U(x)})H^{\otimes m}$ with $q_U(x)=\operatorname{wt}(\Pi_Ux)\bmod4$ $(x\in\mathbb F_2^m$ the address, $\operatorname{wt}$ Hamming weight, $H$ Hadamard), so $\mathcal C_{\mathcal F}=C^{\otimes m}$ for the kernel $C=H\operatorname{diag}(1,i)H=\alpha+\beta\,\mathrm{sh},\ \alpha=\frac{1+i}2,\ \beta=\frac{1-i}2,$ $\mathrm{sh}$ swapping two entries.

symbols.name: phase exponent
symbols.meaning: The Hamming weight of the binary projection of the address onto U, modulo 4.
symbols.quote: A complex-network label $U$ gets $\mathcal C_U=H^{\otimes m}\operatorname{diag}_x(i^{q_U(x)})H^{\otimes m}$ with $q_U(x)=\operatorname{wt}(\Pi_Ux)\bmod4$ $(x\in\mathbb F_2^m$ the address, $\operatorname{wt}$ Hamming weight, $H$ Hadamard), so $\mathcal C_{\mathcal F}=C^{\otimes m}$ for the kernel $C=H\operatorname{diag}(1,i)H=\alpha+\beta\,\mathrm{sh},\ \alpha=\frac{1+i}2,\ \beta=\frac{1-i}2,$ $\mathrm{sh}$ swapping two entries.

symbols.name: translation by e
symbols.meaning: The operator translating an array on F_2^m by the vector e.
symbols.quote: As $\operatorname{wt}(e)$ is odd and $H\operatorname{diag}(1,-1)H=\mathrm{sh}$ turns $(-1)^{e\cdot x}$ into $\mathrm{sh}_e,$ $(\mathrm{sh}_ef)(x)=f(x+e),$ each $e$ gives one kernel $\alpha+\beta\,\mathrm{sh}_e$ or its inverse; so $s_{\rm c}=W_{\rm c}m-2N+2L_{\rm c}<W_{\rm c}m$ as $L_{\rm c}<N$ holds.

symbols.name: sign matrix
symbols.meaning: The diagonal matrix diag(1,-1).
symbols.quote: On $X_a\to Y_a,$ $q_{U_a^\perp}-q_{U_a}\equiv\operatorname{wt}(x)+2[u_a\cdot x]$ gives $C^{-1}$ on $\operatorname{supp}u_a$ $(27$ coordinates), fixed by $Z=\operatorname{diag}(1,-1)$ there before and $i^{27}Z$ after since $C=iZC^{-1}Z.$

derivations.quote: Triple indicators $t_S,t_T$ have coordinate sum $3,$ so $\langle t_S,t_T\rangle=|S\cap T|-\frac{3\cdot3}9=|S\cap T|-1$ and $\langle t_T,t_T\rangle=2;$ the complex network uses $F=\mathbb F_2^h$ with the dot product, $t_S\cdot t_T=|S\cap T|\bmod 2.$ So triple lines $\langle t_T\rangle$ are nondegenerate and neighbors $(|S\cap T|=1,$ resp. $|S\cap T|\in\{0,2\})$ are orthogonal. Labels lie in $\mathcal F=F^{\otimes3}$ of $h\times h\times h$ arrays, $g\otimes g'\otimes g''$ having entries $g_{k_1}g'_{k_2}g''_{k_3}$ and forms multiplying factorwise.
so sources total dimension $N$ and sinks $Nm+N(m-1)+(W-2N)m=Wm-N.$

Writing $K=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle\otimes K',$ the next stage has $A'=A\otimes F,\ P'=P\otimes\langle t_T\rangle,\ B'=(P')^\perp_{A'}$ and $K',$ making these its incoming labels from $U_a,0$ to $\mathcal F,U_a^\perp.$

Labels nest along every edge, the side edge $2\to5$ since neighbors $S,T$ satisfy $\langle t_S\rangle\subset t_T^\perp.$ Only central-wire edges $3\to4$ decrease, each losing $P\otimes F$ of dimension $h,$ so $L=Ich.$ Gates keep one label, so changes telescope along wires: signed ones total $(Wm-N)-N$ and absolute ones $Wm-2N+2L.$
Thus $L/N=3ch/\binom h3=c/539,$ giving $L_{\rm b}/N=100/539$ and $L_{\rm c}/N=101/539$ below one half.

Bit-network label $U$ gets the [address shear](address-shear.md) by the projection $\Pi_U$ onto $U$ along $U^\perp$ $(-\Pi_{U_a}$ at sources of $X_a);$ so every route gets the shear $\mathrm{id}:$ $\Pi_{U_a^\perp}-(-\Pi_{U_a})$ on $X_a\to Y_a$ and $\Pi_{\mathcal F}-0$ elsewhere. An edge $U\subset V$ costs $\operatorname{rank}(\Pi_V-\Pi_U)=\operatorname{rank}\Pi_{V\cap U^\perp}=\dim V-\dim U,$ except the first edge of $X_a,$ into $U_a$ as $B=0,$ costing $\operatorname{rank}2\Pi_{U_a}=1.$ So $s_{\rm b}=W_{\rm b}m-2N+2L_{\rm b}+N<W_{\rm b}m$ because $2L_{\rm b}<N$ holds.

As $\operatorname{wt}(e)$ is odd and $H\operatorname{diag}(1,-1)H=\mathrm{sh}$ turns $(-1)^{e\cdot x}$ into $\mathrm{sh}_e,$ $(\mathrm{sh}_ef)(x)=f(x+e),$ each $e$ gives one kernel $\alpha+\beta\,\mathrm{sh}_e$ or its inverse; so $s_{\rm c}=W_{\rm c}m-2N+2L_{\rm c}<W_{\rm c}m$ as $L_{\rm c}<N$ holds. On $X_a\to Y_a,$ $q_{U_a^\perp}-q_{U_a}\equiv\operatorname{wt}(x)+2[u_a\cdot x]$ gives $C^{-1}$ on $\operatorname{supp}u_a$ $(27$ coordinates), fixed by $Z=\operatorname{diag}(1,-1)$ there before and $i^{27}Z$ after since $C=iZC^{-1}Z.$ Negating physical $X$ outputs and undoing the exchange leaves $C^{\otimes m}$ everywhere.
